laat_vaar.voor: soos voorheen van jag en versamel geleef
laat_vaar.na: soos voorheen gejag en veldkos versamel
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Versamel' used as a bare noun after 'van' reads stiffly; the verb form matches the block's own second sentence and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Van jag en versamel leef' is acceptable Afrikaans and says hunting and gathering was the San's livelihood; the proposal drops 'geleef' and only says they hunted and gathered, which the Khoikhoi also did (block 3), so the contrast weakens and the meaning moves.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Op soek na gras en water
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Temporal 'after' is written 'ná' to separate it from directional 'na'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The accent on temporal 'ná' is only needed where 'na' could be misread, and 'Na 'n ruk' is unambiguous.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die Khoikhoi het ook nog gejag
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die Khoikhoi het nog steeds gejag
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Avoids a second 'ook' straight after 'Die diere het ook vleis gegee'; meaning is unchanged.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Ook nog' means 'in addition to their livestock', while 'nog steeds' shifts it to 'continued over time', so the meaning narrows.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die koeie het melk gegee, en melk was 'n belangrike kos vir die Khoikhoi.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die Khoikhoi se koeie het melk gegee, en melk was vir hulle 'n belangrike kos.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The block opens with 'Die koeie' without an antecedent in the block; naming the owners first makes the reference clear without changing the claim.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The same sentence already names the Khoikhoi and the previous block is about their herds, so the reference is clear; the proposal is a lateral reordering.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: Baie van die San se rotskuns wys
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Baie' before the mass noun 'San-rotskuns' reads awkwardly; 'baie van die San se rotskuns' is the natural form and keeps the quantifier.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Baie' with a mass noun such as 'San-rotskuns' is normal Afrikaans; the proposal is longer and only reads differently.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Op soek na gras en water
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: die gras op een plek klaar opgevreet
laat_vaar_vorige.na: die gras op die plek klaar opgevreet
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'op een plek' can read as 'in one single spot'; 'op die plek' points clearly to where the herders were camped.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'op een plek' is natural Afrikaans for grass being eaten bare in one area, while 'op die plek' has no place named earlier to point back to, so this is a lateral move at best.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Sowat 2 000 jaar gelede het mense hier in die Later Steentydperk ook begin
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Sowat 2 000 jaar gelede, in die Later Steentydperk, het mense hier ook begin
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'hier in die Later Steentydperk' runs a place word straight into a time phrase and reads as if the Stone Age were a place; setting the time phrase off keeps the meaning and reads smoothly.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Stacking 'hier' and a time phrase is ordinary Afrikaans and reads clearly; the comma-set apposition is a lateral move that adds an interruption for a Grade 5 reader.
